description.narrative: IFC expects the Project to improve access to high-yield hybrid maize and rice seeds and technical assistance for farmers, and to generate economy wide effects in terms of job creation and value addition. Beyond the Project, IFC expects its financing to contribute to improving the resilience of the rice production sector in Ecuador by catalyzing productivity improvement through supporting the launch of the first hybrid rice seeds in the country.

Interoc S.A. and its subsidiaries (Interoc or the Group) is a mid-sized multinational agribusiness group of Ecuadorian origin with over 30 years of experience specializing in high-yield maize and rice seeds and crop protection solutions. The Group operates with a vertically integrated model and a strong focus on research and development, enabling it to deliver differentiated products and technical assistance to farmers and distributors. Interoc has a regional presence across Ecuador, Peru, Colombia, and Central America. The proposed project will finance the development of a rice seeds germplasm program allowing the Group to distribute the first hybrid rice seed variety in the Andean Region, with higher yields and improved resilience to climate variability, while also strengthening the Groups capacity for the production and distribution of hybrid maize seeds.
